_meta.notes: The version now lives in index.html, in a meta tag, because that is the one file a reload always refetches. This file mirrors it so the app can say when a device is running a part cached page, and it carries the notes a student reads. Bump both together: the sweep fails if they disagree. Entries are for the person using it: what is different on their screen, never what changed in the code.

releases.head: The game talks the way I would
changes: Every choice and every outcome is in my own words now. It says my best subject and my Early Admissions folder, not yours.
The options say what they actually mean. Guard your own oxygen is gone, and so is Keep one made thing alive.
The things that fill a real school year are in: class comm, CCA EXCO, the Sec 3 immersion trip, a programme outside school, leading a VIA project, tutoring somebody younger.
Some choices now pay off for the rest of the game. Build a study routine and every year after it gives me one more point.
CCA, VIA, PW, EXCO, DSA, ORD and NYAA are all in Words now, so anyone can look them up.
The button at the end of a year says That is my year.
On a phone, the button that starts the game and the button that ends a year are where a thumb can reach them. They were off the bottom of the screen.
The version is printed at the bottom of every page, so a teacher can check the class is on the same one.

releases.head: This is version 2
changes: The game plays in chapters now: school year by year, then the milestones that actually shape the years after, National Service included if it is part of your road.
Every figure that could be checked against MOE has been, and the ones that could not still say so.
The list of places never changes order. It never did rank you, and now it cannot.
Your class code now means what your teacher says it means.
A landing page that asks you one question before anything else.
